glosses: half (one of two equal parts of any whole)
synonym of cuarto, half-fanega (a traditional unit of dry measure equivalent to about 27.8 L)
stocking (long thin leggings worn by women)

examples.en: He will be here in half an hour.

examples.text: Ella me hizo esperar media hora.
examples.en: She made me wait for half an hour.

examples.text: Deberías haber salido media hora antes.
examples.en: You should have left half an hour earlier.

examples.text: Tienes hasta las dos y media.
